name: Jay Darlington
description: '''Jay Peter Darlington''' (born 3 May 1968) is an English keyboardist, best known as a member of psychedelic rock band [[Kula Shaker]]. He went on to work as a touring member of the rock band [[Oasis (band)|Oasis]] from 2002 to 2009 before re-joining Kula Shaker in late 2022 as a full-time member during the recording of their seventh album, ''[[Natural Magick]]''.
